title: /arena
line: Compare two candidates and bring their best parts together.

beats.caption: You enable subagents and give Arena a small task.
Two scripted seats work in separate Git worktrees.
The rubric selects a base and one useful improvement.
The combined version passes both checks.

takeaway.title: Select a base by rubric
takeaway.line: Carry over a specific improvement and check the result.

title.text: Arena helps when two plausible designs could take the code in different directions. This run uses two scripted model seats.

scene.text: Each seat builds its own greeting candidate in a separate worktree. The scorecard favors the simpler parser as a base. The other candidate contributes normalization for blank names.

takeaway.text: The parent combines those two parts and runs both checks on the result. You can see exactly what made it into the final change.

aside.title: The rubric
aside.note: Two isolated candidates with scripted replies.
